about_the_game:
The Demon King Returns—A Lone Revenge!

Long ago, the mighty Thunder Demon King brought despair to the world. Now, after centuries of being sealed away, he has awakened once more! Determined to rebuild his glorious age of darkness, he sets out to crush the kingdom’s soldiers standing in his way.

Thunder of the Demon King is an action tower defense game with simple controls and intense battles. Master the thunder attacks that grow stronger when charged, defeat enemies efficiently to power up, and take down the powerful bosses that await!

The Demon King Returns—A Lone Revenge!

Long ago, the mighty Thunder Demon King brought despair to the world. Now, after centuries of being sealed away, he has awakened once more! Determined to rebuild his glorious age of darkness, he sets out to crush the kingdom’s soldiers standing in his way.

A thrilling defense battle with simple controls!

Master the thunder attack, which changes its range depending on how long you press, and defeat enemies efficiently. Use stage gimmicks to stall enemies and wipe out the enemy forces in one strike!

Power up to gain the upper hand in battle!

Collect magic stones dropped by enemies to strengthen the Demon King. Increase your stats or unlock powerful special moves to handle unexpected enemy hordes!

Defeat powerful bosses!

Prepare for the battle against the boss waiting at the end of each stage.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
